svg.text: D2 — Account map, PDA seeds and ownership
Every account: owner program · seeds · fields · who may mutate it. Bumps are stored at init and re-verified; never recomputed on-chain.
id: u64 price: u64 close_ts: i64
mutated by: create · buy · commit · settle · cancel
mutated by: system transfer, vault-seed signed
seeds address: keypair signer at create
mutated by: Core program (CPI from create_campaign)
seeds address: fresh keypair signer at buy
Payout NEVER reads asset owner -> Ticket.buyer
mutated by: Core program (CPI from buy_ticket)
seeds keypair created by keeper (SB SDK)
owner must == pinned SB id (devnet/mainnet differ)
mutated by: receives the fee at settle
Each is validated by: owner program, seeds+bump,
UncheckedAccount only for the Core asset /
collection and treasury, each with a CHECK.
Program IDs pinned (never read from instruction accounts)
Rent: Config, Campaign and Ticket rent is paid by the payer (admin, or buyer). Per-purchase rent for Ticket + Core asset is NOT yet measured:
measure it on devnet in build step B4b before setting the ticket price. The chain-facts report quotes 0.00128 and 0.004 SOL for the same item.
